verdict.rationale: Remote documents an official CLI whose commands can all emit JSON (and CSV for list commands) for use in scripts, plus a REST API with per-integration tokens and a sandbox token issued with no dashboard step. Together these support headless, scriptable automation. Nothing explicitly documents CI pipeline use or non-interactive CLI authentication. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs, non-interactive CLI auth guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: every command can emit JSON, so the output drops straight into spreadsheets and scripts
a working `ra_test_` token by email — no dashboard step needed for this path
